item.title: Disney Jr. sets March premiere dates for preschool series "BeddyByes" and "Magicampers"
item.description: From magical camp adventures to cozy sleep routines, Disney Jr.'s latest shows are almost here! Watch the premieres of "BeddyByes" on March 2 and "Magicampers" on March 23 streaming the next day on Disney+.

item.title: Vegetation fire in Liberty County fully contained following mutual aid response, Dayton VFD says
item.description: SkyEye was over a massive fire burning in Liberty County that prompted the Dayton Volunteer Fire Department to call for backup.

item.title: Commissioner's court argues over possible door construction at Harris Co. Administration Building
item.description: Discussion over renovations at the Harris County Administration Building turned heated on Thursday at Commissioner's Court.

item.title: Realtors say Houston homes selling for less but sitting on housing market for longer
item.description: Houses in the Houston area are getting cheaper, but homes are still sitting on the market longer than in the past.

item.title: Search for suspect underway after teenager shot during argument outside Baytown home, HCSO says
item.description: Investigators are searching for the person who shot a 19-year-old in front of his home at a mobile home park just north of the Baytown airport.

item.title: Minnesota man indicted after allegedly impersonating FBI agent to break Luigi Mangione out of jail
item.description: Mark Anderson, 36, allegedly went to the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn on Jan. 28 posing as a federal agent and claimed to have a court order to release Mangione.

item.title: Texas City Museum welcomes new piece of Black cowboy history
item.description: The Texas City Museum is displaying a piece of Black cowboy history after the family of a formerly enslaved man donated a historic artifact.

item.title: 5 arrested for stealing electricity at illegal encampment in southeast Houston, police say
item.description: Police say they arrested five men on Wednesday for stealing electricity to power a southeast Houston homeless encampment.

item.title: Newly proposed Houston Texans facility in NW Harris County will cost taxpayers $150M, Hidalgo says
item.description: Officials said taxpayers will not fund the facility itself but will pay for the new infrastructure for the area, as well as any public buildings that will need to be constructed.

item.title: Houston ISD to close 12 schools in upcoming 2026-27 school year, district says
item.description: The Houston Independent School District announced a plan that the district will move forward with the closure of 12 schools at the beginning of the fall 2026 school year.
